{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Juo Deltar Faces Gamblor the Terrible''''' was a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] of the [[Jedi Action genre]]. It focused on [[Juo Deltar]], a scoundrel-type adventurer and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], fighting [[Gamblor]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nek Lawsirk]] borrowed it from [[Hedrett Holovid]], a holovid shop located in [[Hedrett]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
